require 'bunny'
require 'zlib'
require 'json'
require 'logger'
require 'securerandom'

module MessageProcessor
  class Config
    DEFAULTS = {
      max_message_size: 10 * 1024 * 1024,
      max_decompressed_ratio: 100,
      queue_name: 'processing_queue',
      amqp_url: 'amqp://localhost',
      log_level: Logger::INFO,
      decompression_strategy: 'streaming'
    }.freeze

    attr_reader :settings

    def initialize
      @settings = DEFAULTS.dup
      load_environment_overrides
    end

    def max_message_size
      @settings[:max_message_size]
    end

    def max_decompressed_ratio
      @settings[:max_decompressed_ratio]
    end

    def decompression_strategy
      @settings[:decompression_strategy]
    end

    private

    def load_environment_overrides
      if ENV['MQ_MAX_MESSAGE_SIZE']
        @settings[:max_message_size] = ENV['MQ_MAX_MESSAGE_SIZE'].to_i
      end
      if ENV['MQ_MAX_RATIO']
        @settings[:max_decompressed_ratio] = ENV['MQ_MAX_RATIO'].to_i
      end
      if ENV['MQ_QUEUE_NAME']
        @settings[:queue_name] = ENV['MQ_QUEUE_NAME']
      end
      if ENV['MQ_AMQP_URL']
        @settings[:amqp_url] = ENV['MQ_AMQP_URL']
      end
      if ENV['MQ_DECOMPRESSION_STRATEGY']
        @settings[:decompression_strategy] = ENV['MQ_DECOMPRESSION_STRATEGY']
      end
    end
  end

  class SafeDecompressor
    def initialize(config)
      @config = config
      @logger = Logger.new(STDOUT)
    end

    def decompress(data)
      case @config.decompression_strategy
      when 'streaming'
        streaming_decompress(data)
      when 'bounded'
        bounded_decompress(data)
      else
        streaming_decompress(data)
      end
    end

    private

    def streaming_decompress(data)
      output = StringIO.new
      stream = Zlib::Inflate.new(Zlib::MAX_WBITS + 16)
      max_output = compute_max_output(data.bytesize)

      begin
        chunk_size = 4096
        offset = 0
        while offset < data.bytesize
          chunk = data.byteslice(offset, chunk_size)
          decompressed_chunk = stream.inflate(chunk)
          output.write(decompressed_chunk)

          if output.size > max_output
            raise DecompressionBombError, "Output exceeds maximum allowed size (#{max_output} bytes)"
          end

          offset += chunk_size
        end
        stream.finish rescue nil
      ensure
        stream.close
      end

      output.string
    end

    def bounded_decompress(data)
      max_output = compute_max_output(data.bytesize)
      result = Zlib::Inflate.new(Zlib::MAX_WBITS + 16).inflate(data)

      if result.bytesize > max_output
        raise DecompressionBombError, "Output exceeds maximum allowed size"
      end

      result
    end

    def compute_max_output(input_size)
      ratio_limit = @config.max_decompressed_ratio
      size_limit = @config.max_message_size
      computed = input_size * ratio_limit
      [computed, size_limit].min
    end
  end

  class DecompressionBombError < StandardError; end

  class Consumer
    def initialize
      @config = Config.new
      @decompressor = SafeDecompressor.new(@config)
      @logger = Logger.new(STDOUT)
      @logger.level = @config.settings[:log_level]
    end

    def start
      connection = Bunny.new(@config.settings[:amqp_url])
      connection.start
      channel = connection.create_channel
      queue = channel.queue(@config.settings[:queue_name], durable: true)

      @logger.info("Consumer started, listening on #{@config.settings[:queue_name]}")
      @logger.info("Decompression strategy: #{@config.decompression_strategy}")
      @logger.info("Max ratio: #{@config.max_decompressed_ratio}, Max size: #{@config.max_message_size}")

      queue.subscribe(block: true, manual_ack: true) do |delivery_info, properties, payload|
        process_message(channel, delivery_info, properties, payload)
      end
    rescue Interrupt
      @logger.info("Shutting down consumer")
      connection&.close
    end

    private

    def process_message(channel, delivery_info, properties, payload)
      request_id = SecureRandom.uuid
      @logger.info("[#{request_id}] Received message (#{payload.bytesize} bytes)")

      if payload.bytesize > @config.max_message_size
        @logger.warn("[#{request_id}] Message too large, rejecting")
        channel.nack(delivery_info.delivery_tag, false, false)
        return
      end

      content_encoding = properties.content_encoding
      data = if content_encoding == 'gzip'
               validate_and_decompress(payload, request_id)
             else
               payload
             end

      return channel.nack(delivery_info.delivery_tag, false, false) unless data

      handle_payload(data, request_id)
      channel.ack(delivery_info.delivery_tag)
    rescue DecompressionBombError => e
      @logger.error("[#{request_id}] Decompression bomb detected: #{e.message}")
      channel.nack(delivery_info.delivery_tag, false, false)
    rescue => e
      @logger.error("[#{request_id}] Error processing message: #{e.message}")
      channel.nack(delivery_info.delivery_tag, false, true)
    end

    def validate_and_decompress(payload, request_id)
      @logger.info("[#{request_id}] Decompressing gzip payload")
      @decompressor.decompress(payload)
    end

    def handle_payload(data, request_id)
      parsed = JSON.parse(data)
      @logger.info("[#{request_id}] Successfully processed message type: #{parsed['type']}")
      parsed
    rescue JSON::ParserError => e
      @logger.error("[#{request_id}] Invalid JSON: #{e.message}")
      nil
    end
  end
end

if __FILE__ == $0
  consumer = MessageProcessor::Consumer.new
  consumer.start
end
